purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Lurambi Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 300 DPI (4-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; the TOTAL row is the final green-shaded row on page 3, immediately after the 'KAKAMEGA MAIN - 01' and 'KAKAMEGA WOMEN - 01' special-facility polling station rows). The TOTAL row and both prison rows are unambiguous at this resolution.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-202-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 51,073 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (89,770) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (89,627). The 143-voter gap exactly equals the sum of two special-facility polling stations printed on the same page immediately above the TOTAL row: KAKAMEGA MAIN - 01 (135 registered voters) and KAKAMEGA WOMEN - 01 (8 registered voters), which sit in a national-facility ward code outside the ordinary Lurambi constituency ward series that the governed First Schedule denominator sums from. This is the same genuine printed-total-vs-ward-derived-denominator gap already documented for other constituencies' special-facility polling stations. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
